featured.title: Eterna 1.2 is out
featured.body: The latest update brings a new step-probability engine, per-voice panning, and a reworked sample import flow. Plus a handful of stability fixes and small quality-of-life improvements across the board.

news.title: Eterna 1.2 — step probability & voice panning
news.body: Each step can now carry an independent probability value. Combine with the new per-voice panning to build patterns that feel alive without losing rhythmic intent.

news.title: Eterna on norns — getting started
news.body: A short walkthrough covering installation, sample loading, and the basics of the six-voice layout. Written for first-time norns users.

news.title: Community patch exchange
news.body: A thread on llllllll.co where people share Eterna patches, sample kits, and modulation setups. Worth a look if you are just starting out.

news.title: etsuko.fm on GitHub
news.body: All source code is public. Issues, pull requests, and feature discussions happen in the open.
